verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe shows a project-local install: `npx skills add ... --copy` placed the skill under ./.claude/skills/ in the project directory, where it could be committed with the repo. User-global scope is only implied by the skills doc's mention of `~/.agents/skills/` as a cross-runtime alias, and installs otherwise go through each harness's own mechanism. missing for 10: documented first-party choice between project and user-global scope, explicit evidence of a user-global install working, guidance on committing project-local skills to the repo.
